instruction.task: Write and run a Bitburner script that maximizes money by hacking servers. First, do a quick scan to find hackable servers, then continuously hack the best one. The script should: 1) Scan all servers reachable from home (use ns.scan recursively), 2) For each server, get its info using individual cheap getters: ns.getServerMaxMoney, ns.getServerMoneyAvailable, ns.getServerRequiredHackingLevel, ns.getServerMinSecurityLevel, ns.getServerSecurityLevel, ns.getHackingLevel, 3) Find the server with highest max money that you can hack (required hacking level <= your hacking level), 4) Run a loop: if security > minSecurity+5, weaken it; else if money < maxMoney*0.75, grow it; else hack it. Use ns.weaken, ns.grow, ns.hack which are cheap (~0.1-0.2 GB each). Do NOT use ns.getServer (costs 2 GB) or ns.hackAnalyzeChance (costs 1 GB). The script runs on 'home' server. Start with scanning and hacking 'n00dles' as a fallback if no better target found.

instruction.task: Write a Bitburner hacking script that first gains root access on servers using ns.nuke(), then continuously hacks them. The script must: 1) Recursively scan all servers from 'home' using ns.scan(). 2) For each server, use ns.getServerNumPortsRequired(srv) to check required ports, and ns.getServerRequiredHackingLevel(srv) to check hacking level requirement. 3) To get root access: if portCount is 0, call ns.nuke(srv) directly. Store successfully nuked servers. 4) Among nuked servers, find the one with highest ns.getServerMaxMoney(srv) that also satisfies ns.getServerRequiredHackingLevel(srv) <= ns.getHackingLevel(). 5) If no suitable server found, use 'n00dles' and try to nuke it (0 ports needed). 6) Then loop forever: check ns.getServerSecurityLevel(target) vs ns.getServerMinSecurityLevel(target)+5, check ns.getServerMoneyAvailable(target) vs ns.getServerMaxMoney(target)*0.75, then call ns.weaken(target), ns.grow(target), or ns.hack(target) accordingly. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use ns.getServer (2GB cost), ns.hackAnalyzeChance (1GB cost), ns.brutessh, ns.ftpcrack, or any port-opening functions - just ns.nuke() for 0-port servers. Use only cheap APIs: ns.scan, ns.nuke, ns.hack, ns.weaken, ns.grow, ns.getHackingLevel, ns.getServerMaxMoney, ns.getServerMoneyAvailable, ns.getServerRequiredHackingLevel, ns.getServerMinSecurityLevel, ns.getServerSecurityLevel, ns.getServerNumPortsRequired.
